questions.question: What is the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 8,100 for 1(1)/(4) years at 8% per annum, if the interest is compounded 5-monthly? (Nearest to Rs.1)
questions.solution:
Time = 1(1)/(4) years = [5/4] × 12 = 15 months

Rate = 8% annum

If the interest is compounded 5 monthly, then

Time = 15/5 = 3

Rate = [8/12] × 5 = [10/3]%

As we know,

Amount = P [1 + (r/100)]

A = 8100 × (31/30) × (31/30) × (31/30) = 8937.3

∴ Interest = A – P = 8937.3 – 8100 = 837.3

questions.question: By how much percentage above the cost price should an article be marked up for sale so that after allowing two successive discounts of 20% and 6.25% on it, a net gain of 20% is made on the cost?
questions.solution:
We can write, 20% = 1/5 and 6.25 = 1/16

Let the marked price of the article be 100x.

SP of the article after two successive discounts = 100x × [4/5] × [15/16] = 75x

∵ Net gain of 20% is made on the CP

⇒ CP of the article = 75x × (100/120) = 62.5x

MP is more than CP by = 100x – 62.5x = 37.5x

∴ Required percentage = [37.5/62.5] × 100 = 60%

questions.question: Two chords AB and CD of lengths 5 cm and 11 cm respectively are parallel and are on the same side of the centre O of a circle. If the distance between the chords is 3 cm, then what is the diameter of the circle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0be23deeccb32ff07197bc9ea5e57c654f4a7ca837bd85ac093a8d0520d181c6.png] 

⇒ AB = 5 cm, and CD = 11 cm

⇒ AM = MB = 5/2 cm

⇒ CN = ND = 11/2 cm

Let ON be x cm and radius OB = OD = r cm

In ΔOND

⇒ (OD)² = (ND)² + (ON)² [By Pythagoras theorem]

⇒ r² = (11/2)² + (x)²

⇒ r² = (121/4) + x² ----(1)

In ΔOBM

⇒ (OB)² = (OM)² + (MB)² [By Pythagoras theorem]

⇒ r² = (3 + x)² + (5/2)²

⇒ r² = 3² + x² + 6x + [25/4] ----(2)

From equation (1) and equation (2)

⇒ [121/4] + x² = 9 + x² + 6x + [ 25/4]

⇒ 6x = [121/4] – [25/4] – 9

⇒ x = 5/2 cm

From equation (1)

⇒ r² = [121/4] + [5/2]²

⇒ r = √(146)/2

⇒ Diameter of the circle 2r = √146 cm

questions.question: A sum of Rs. x is divided among A, B and C such that the ratio of shares of A and B is 7 : 12 and that of B and C is 8 : 5. If the difference in the shares of A and C is Rs. 214, then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
Ratio of A and B = 7 : 12 ----(1)

Ratio of B and C = 8 : 5 ----(2)

Multiply by 2 in equation (1) and multiply by 3 in equation (2)

Ratio of A and B = 14 : 24

Ratio of A and B = 24 : 15

Ratio of A, B and C = 14 : 24 : 15

Difference of A and C = 15 – 14 = 1 unit

⇒ 1 unit represents = 214

⇒ A + B + C = 14 + 24 + 15 = 53 unit

53 unit will represent = 214 × 53 = 11,342

∴ Value of (A + B + C) = 11,342

questions.question: A cylindrical road roller made of metal is one meter long. Its inner radius is 27 cm and the thickness of the metal sheet rolled into it is 9 cm. What is the weight of the roller, if 1 cm³ of the metal weight 8 g?
questions.solution:
Inner radius of cylindrical road roller r = 27 cm

Outer radius of cylindrical road roller R = 27 + 9 = 36 cm

Height of road roller = 1 m = 100 cm

Volume of cylindrical road roller = π(R² – r²) h = π(36² – 27²) × 100 = 56700π cm³

Given that 1 cm³ = 8 g

Suppose, 56700π cm³ = X

X = 8 × 56700π = 453600π g

453600π g = 453.6π kg

questions.question: Surbhi spends 75% of her income. If her income increases by 20% and saving decrease by 1% then the percentage increase in her expenditure is:
questions.solution:
Let the income of Surbhi be 100x.

Expenditure of Surbhi = 100x × (75/100) = 75x

Savings of Surbhi = 100x – 75x = 25x

Surbhi’s new income = 100x × (120/100) = 120x

New savings of Surbhi = 25x × (99/100) = 24.75x

New Expenditure of Surbhi = 120x – 24.75x = 95.25x

∴ Required percentage = [(95.25x – 75x)/75x] × 100 = (20.25x/75x) × 100 = 27%

questions.question: A person sells an article at a profit of 12%. If he had purchased it for 12% less and sold it for Rs. 9 less, he would have gained 27%. What is the original cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
Let the CP of the article be x.

If the person sells the article of 12% Profit, then SP of the article = x × (112/100)

If the person had purchased the article for 12% less, the new CP of the article = x × (88/100)

According to the question

⇒ [(112x/100) – 9] – (88x/100) = (27/100) × (88x/100)

⇒ 1.12x – 9 – 0.88x = 0.2376x

⇒ 1.12x – 1.1176x = 9

⇒ x = 9/0.0024 = 3750

**Alternate solution∶**

Let the cost price of the article be Rs. 100.

⇒ Selling price would be Rs. 112.

New cost price (12% less) = Rs 88

New selling price (27% profit) = 127% of 88 = Rs. 111.76

Now, the difference between both selling prices = 112 – 111.76 = Rs. 0.24

When the difference is 0.24, CP = Rs. 100

When the difference is 9, CP = 100 × 9/0.24 = Rs. 3750

Hence the cost price of the article is Rs. 3750.

questions.question: In ∆ABC, AM ⊥ BC and AN is the bisector of ∠A. What is the measure of ∠MAN, if ∠B = 55° and ∠C = 35°?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/154f1faa4aace511daba4f2609fceaad39f2ad59eb70104fca78e6593350119f.png] 

Given, ∠B = 55° & ∠C = 35°

As we know,

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠A = 180° – 55° – 35° = 90°

∴ ∠BAN = (∠A/2) = 90/2 = 45

In ΔAMB

⇒ ∠BAM + ∠ABM + ∠BMA = 180

⇒ ∠BAM = 180° – 55° – 90°

⇒ ∠BAM = 35°

Now,

⇒ ∠MAN = ∠BAN – ∠BAM = 45° – 35° = 10°

**Short trick **

⇒ ∠MAN = (∠B – ∠C)/2 = (55° – 35°)/2 = 10°

questions.question: The ratio of the efficiencies of A, B and C is 3 : 5 : 1. Working together, they can complete a piece of work in 5 days. A and B work together for 3 days. The remaining work will be completed by C alone in?
questions.solution:
Efficiency ratio of A, B and C = 3 : 5 : 1

Total work = (3 + 5 + 1) × 5 = 9 × 5 = 45

Work done by A and B in three days = (3 + 5) × 3 = 24

Remaining work = 45 – 24 = 21

C will complete the remaining work in = 21/1 = 21 days
